onTurnEnd.name: Apply fixes
onTurnEnd.message: Apply the fixes the review found, then run go test ./...
onTurnEnd.condition: The message lists at least one specific review finding that is still open. Answer NO if it says nothing is left to apply, or lists findings only as skipped, declined, deferred or already fixed

onTurnEnd.name: Open PR
onTurnEnd.message: Commit the changes, push the branch and open the PR with gh pr create, then watch its checks.
onTurnEnd.condition: The message is a reply to the code review or to applying its fixes, and lists no review findings left to fix. Missing tests and uncommitted changes don't count as findings

prFlow.changesRequestedMessage: PR #{{prNumber}} ({{prUrl}}) got review comments. Read them with `gh pr view {{prUrl}} --comments` and the inline ones with `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{{prNumber}}/comments`, address them, push, and reply to each.
